resources.string: Warning: these options allow writes that are not confirmed for your monitor model. Such a write can permanently corrupt the monitor\'s settings. They are meant only for people validating a model with a monitor they are prepared to lose.
Allow clock sync on monitors where it is untested

Setting the clock has not been confirmed on these monitor models. Doing it anyway can permanently corrupt the monitor's settings or make it unusable.

This switch does not send anything by itself. If you later set the clock on such a monitor, the device report records that an untested write was attempted.

You are responsible for any damage to your monitor.
Allow profile registration on monitors where it is untested

Profile registration writes the selected user and the clock into the monitor's settings. It has not been confirmed on these monitor models. Doing it anyway can permanently corrupt the monitor's settings or make it unusable.

This switch does not send anything by itself. Registration still runs only when you choose Pair and confirm it, and the device report records that an untested write was attempted.

You are responsible for any damage to your monitor.
These switches turn on connection paths that exist in the app but have never been tested on a real monitor. They may simply fail.
Use the encrypted connection when pairing an X7
Allow clock sync over an encrypted X7 connection

This path exists in the app but has never been tested on a real monitor, and it may simply fail. Pairing this way can replace the monitor's existing pairing with this phone. A failed write can permanently corrupt the monitor's settings or make it unusable.

This switch does not send anything by itself. The device report lists which developer switches were in effect.

You are responsible for any damage to your monitor.
Developer options hidden; all developer switches are off
